import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007;
    static long total_sum, total_n, count_one, total_count;
    static long[] power = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static List<Long>[] level_vals = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sum_levels = new long[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            level_vals[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean check_range(long x) {
        final long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999 <= total_n && x * limit * 10 > total_n;
    }

    static void build_levels(int level, long prefix) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            long val = (count_one - prefix + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
            level_vals[level].add(val);
            sum_levels[level] += val;
            count_one++;
            build_levels(level + 1, prefix * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void explore(int level, long num) {
        if (num > total_n) return;
        if (check_range(num)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long current_val = ((total_count + 1 - (num * power[i]) % MOD_A) + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                List<Long> list = level_vals[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(list, MOD_A - current_val);
                long size = list.size();
                long sum_level = sum_levels[i];
                long temp = (sum_level + current_val * size - MOD_A * (size - pos)) % MOD_B;
                total_sum = (total_sum + temp) % MOD_B;
            }
            total_count += count_one;
        } else {
            total_count++;
            total_sum = (total_sum + ((total_count - num) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A) % MOD_B;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                explore(level + 1, num * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_sum = 0;
        total_n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        count_one = 0;
        total_count = -1;
        build_levels(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(level_vals[i]);
        }
        explore(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_sum);
    }
}
